description: Formula/*.rb is generated by scripts/render_homebrew_formula.py, so the homebrew manager stays off: edits there are overwritten at the next release.

packageRules.description: Low-risk bumps in one PR to keep the review load down.

The OpenTelemetry crates must move together: bumping one leaves two opentelemetry versions in the tree and SdkTracer stops implementing Tracer. tracing-opentelemetry tracks its own number and trails by a release (0.33 pairs with otel 0.32), so an otel bump is only safe once its partner ships. Dashboard approval surfaces the update without opening a PR that cannot build, rather than a version ceiling that has to be hand-edited every cycle.

The SLIM crates, and a2a-slimrpc built on them, must move together: two slim_auth versions in the tree break the TokenProvider bounds, and mls-rs-crypto-awslc pins aws-lc-rs exactly, so two of its versions never resolve.
Our own crates are released by release-plz, not Renovate.

rusqlite 0.38+ pulls a second libsqlite3-sys (links=sqlite3) that conflicts with agntcy-slim-persistence 0.2.0 → mls-rs-provider-sqlite 0.23 → rusqlite 0.37. Re-enable when slim-persistence moves off rusqlite ^0.37.
